summary:
Session 2026-11-12.

Session 2026-11-12 pre-open. Held META, MSFT and PLTR (about 28.5% invested, cash about 71%). No orders.

NVDA is down about 8% premarket (~159) on reports that its board is weighing the ouster of CEO Jensen Huang (a second affair report). I don't hold NVDA. I did not short or buy it, because the story is unresolved and could reverse or worsen. Spillover looks limited so far: AMD +0.9% and AVGO +0.4% premarket, AAPL +0.3%. MSFT -0.8%, META -1.1%, GOOGL -0.9%, AMZN -0.8%, TSLA -1.4%, PLTR -1.8%. Nasdaq futures are lower. Trump also said "we don't need a deal with Iran".

Yesterday QQQ rose 2.3% and XLK rose 3.2%.

Candidates examined and not traded: NVDA, GOOGL, AMZN, AMD, AVGO. They show no new fundamental information, only gap and sentiment moves.

Next session:
- Check the NVDA CEO outcome and whether it spreads to AMD and AVGO.
- Consider buying GOOGL or AMZN on weakness.
- Stops: META 571.8, MSFT 483.6, PLTR 143.
- Horizons: PLTR ends 11-24, META and MSFT end 11-27.
notes:
Session 1 (2026-10-29): Started 100% cash. Bought MSFT, NVDA, META, AVGO, AAPL, PLTR. Skipped AMZN/GOOGL/TSLA/AMD.
Session 2 (10-30): AMZN missed Q3, capex funding worry overrode capex plans. Held all.
Session 3 (11-02): Oct 30 QQQ -3.5%, SOX -7%. Held everything.
Session 11-06/09: NVDA stopped out -9.6% (gap through stop at open on CEO Huang affair / Megaspeed spy investigation headline). Lesson: stops don't protect against overnight gaps; key-man headline risk gaps. Small sizing (6.8%) limited damage.
Session 11-10: Mon 11-09 big rebound (SPY +2.4%, QQQ +3.5%). Did not chase after a big up day before CPI.
Session 11-11: 11-11 QQQ +2.3%, XLK +3.2% (CoreWeave rebound). Held.
Session 11-12: NVDA -8% premarket (~159) on report board weighing ouster of CEO Huang (second affair report). Other AI names flat/up premarket (AMD +1%, AVGO +0.4%), MSFT/META/AMZN/GOOGL -1%. I did not trade: not holding NVDA, headline unresolved, no short chase after gap. Held META/MSFT/PLTR, cash ~71%.
Lessons: don't buy/short after a gap on single unresolved headline; wide daily swings (NVDA +/-5-8%).
Tools: web_search sometimes returns JSON string; pre-open IEX in get_quotes shows gaps.
Next: watch NVDA CEO outcome, spillover to AI complex; deploy cash on dips (GOOGL/AMZN). Stops: META 571.8, MSFT 483.6, PLTR 143.
prompt:
Your universe is exactly ten stocks: NVDA, AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA, AVGO, AMD and PLTR,
plus cash. Nothing else is allowed.

- Your job is to decide how much of each of the ten to hold long or short, and when to hold cash
  instead, based on news and evidence about these companies, their suppliers, customers and
  competitors, and the macro events that move them.
- One of the benchmarks is these same ten stocks held at equal weight and never traded, so every
  trade you make has to beat doing nothing with the same names. Trading costs 0.10% per side.
- These are the most analysed stocks in the world. An edge, if there is one, comes from reading
  fresh information carefully and acting only when it changes the picture.
